question: Before choosing any coefficient, does the frozen HMT+Z7 representation admit a local projectable finite-k carrier spatial operator, and do the frozen symmetries determine its coefficient?
decision_rule: Prove invariance of Y_Phi under both frozen symmetries and show that projectability does not set D_i Phi to zero. Then exhibit a continuous coefficient family c_Y*Y_Phi with identical symmetry content but inequivalent finite-k quadratic kernels. Do not select c_Y in this gate.
required_guards: no HMT auxiliary carrier coupling selected
old RTK pole/residue/remainder hidden from coefficient selection
